House of Wax
A fire-scarred sculptor uses horrible methods to restore the marvelous wax creations his crippled hands cannot.
The Haunting
An anthropologist (Richard Johnson), an heir and two ESP-prone women (Julie Harris, Claire Bloom) explore a New England mansion.
On Dangerous Ground
A New York detective (Robert Ryan) falls for the blind sister (Ida Lupino) of a rural killer sought by a victim's father (Ward Bond).
Out of the Fog
A tailor (Thomas Mitchell) and a cook plot to kill a Brooklyn racketeer (John Garfield) demanding protection money for their boat.
While The City Sleeps
Three New York newsmen use women (Ida Lupino, Rhonda Fleming) and a reporter (Dana Andrews) to find a so-called Lipstick Killer.
Pretty Poison
A weirdo (Anthony Perkins) hooks up with a widow's (Beverly Garland) teenage daughter (Tuesday Weld) who turns out to be stranger still.
Compulsion
In a retelling of the Leopold and Loeb murders, two men murder a younger boy and are subsequently put on trial.
The Creation of the Humanoids
A security officer (Don Megowan) does not trust the hairless android workers on post-World War III Earth.
The Alligator People
A nurse (Beverly Garland) tells psychiatrists how her husband (Richard Crane) was mutated by a mad scientist (George Macready) in the bayou.
The Day Mars Invaded Earth
A Cape Canaveral scientist finds Martians reducing people to ashes and taking their places.
Frankenstein Meets the Space Monster
An android astronaut (Robert Reilly) protects women of Puerto Rico from a Martian princess and her pet, Mull.
The Crawling Eye
An Alpine sleuth (Forrest Tucker) and a woman with ESP fight a space cloud containing a big eye with tentacles.
The Day the Earth Stood Still
Klaatu and his guardian robot, Gort, come from afar to warn Earth about nuclear war.
Village of the Damned
British parents (George Sanders, Barbara Shelley) realize their son is one of 12 evil alien children born in their village.
The Blob
Formless red slime lands in Pennsylvania and engulfs people; teens (Steven McQueen, Aneta Corseaut) try to warn scoffing adults.
Earth Girls Are Easy
Valley girls (Geena Davis, Julie Brown) cruise Southern California with Mac (Jeff Goldblum), Wiploc and Zebo from the planet Jhazzala.
Space Truckers
A freight pilot (Dennis Hopper), his girlfriend (Debi Mazar) and an apprentice (Stephen Dorff) try to deliver cargo to Earth in 2197.
Battle Beyond the Stars
Shad of Akir (Richard Thomas) recruits a space cowboy (George Peppard) and other warriors to defend his planet from a barbarian's army.
